descriptions.w3d_cc29b_fill_text_8018d35c: Touches the held resource and fills the locked per-character second span when mode is nonzero. Otherwise locks a single width-four item, reusing kind-one/count-one storage by incrementing its16-bit lock count, and assigns the supplied32-bit value. Keeps separate branch returns and the unsigned dynamic-count loop; returns zero. Partial source views do not recover original complete type sizes.
